learnerSignup.comment: Optional: lets the sign-up + course store journey run on the local stack. Leave out to skip it.
learnerSignup.emailLogFile: path to user-management's log when it runs with LOG_JSON=true (the console email backend)
learnerSignup.razorpayKeySecret: the RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET billing-service runs with locally (a test secret, never a live one)
